name: The Nobody in a Hero's World
source:
In The Nobody in a Hero's World, the world of Lunaria is under threat from a great demonic evil... and you're not the destined hero meant to save them. You're not Jesus-Kun; you haven't been summoned and granted power beyond belief; you died an embarrassing death and have been granted a new life, one which also starts in one of the worst ways possible. Grow stronger as you adventure through Lunaria with deep, engaging party & side characters; perform lewd acts such as handholding with your companions; and see the twists that unfold along the way.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DuckDevGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《英雄世界裡的無名小卒》中，盧納利亞正遭受強大惡魔勢力的威脅……而你並不是命中註定要拯救世界的英雄。你不是什麼「耶穌君」，既沒有被召喚而來，也沒有得到超乎想像的力量；你只是以丟臉的方式死去，獲得了第二次生命，而新人生的開端同樣糟糕透頂。與性格豐富、引人入勝的隊友及配角們一同遊歷盧納利亞，逐漸變強；與同伴進行牽手之類的「下流」行為，並見證旅途中接連展開的轉折。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/DuckDevGames]Patreon[/url]]
